post.description: Text subset. Go is sole admission via private Higress ext-auth: Redis rate permit first, then MySQL transaction reserves every enabled budget and slot and rate witness. No automatic generation retry; missing usage retains unknown holds. Responses/Codex full compatibility not claimed.

200.description: Text subset only. No generation retry/replay. One authoritative admission via private Higress ext-auth. stream=true returns SSE; error after stream starts uses event:error and closes without DONE.

schema.description: UTF-8 SSE data JSON chunks. Exactly one data:[DONE] only after normal completion and accounting commit. Post-start failures: event:error with Error JSON, then close without DONE. No buffering. See architecture section 7.
